description: Can reset the password of another Entra user (account takeover of that user).

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Reset password (by admin) / Reset user password' (directory logging is default-on).
A password reset followed by sign-in from a new location can raise ID Protection risk.

prerequisite_privilege: Helpdesk/User/Password Administrator, or Owns over the target user
abuse_primitive: Reset the target's password, then sign in as them (watch for MFA).
notes: Admin password reset is always audited; the follow-on sign-in is the higher-fidelity tell.
